qualifier: E-cadherin and cadherin-11 protein-level control, EMT
name: Cadherin adherens junction adhesion, E-cadherin turnover and EMT
rationale: All members concern cadherin-based adherens junction adhesion and its loss in EMT; unlike confusables (cadherin gene transcription, generic cell-junction sets) the theme centres on post-translational CDH1/CDH11 processing, degradation and signalling.

qualifier: enteric and autonomic neural crest, gut motility
name: Hindbrain and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover hindbrain/brainstem and cranial nerve development and brainstem-controlled functions (suckling, respiration); enteric nervous system, autonomic neural crest migration and peristalsis separate it from spinal cord and peripheral ganglia confusables.

core: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
qualifier: in blood vessel remodeling and wound healing
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching in vessel remodeling
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell differentiation, proliferation, migration, apoptosis and phenotypic switching; vessel remodeling and vascular wound healing distinguish it from cardiac muscle and endothelial confusables.

qualifier: Golgi clathrin sorting of lysosomal enzymes
name: Lysosome-related organelle biogenesis and lysosomal enzyme sorting
rationale: Members cover Golgi/clathrin-dependent cargo sorting to lysosomes and biogenesis of melanosomes, platelet dense granules and synaptic vesicles, distinct from melanin pigmentation and endocytic clathrin confusables.

qualifier: conduction system and cardiomyocyte specification
name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: All members concern embryonic heart tube, chamber and myocardial development; conduction system (SA/AV node, His-Purkinje), ventricular myocardium and cardiomyocyte fate distinguish it from septum, valve/cushion and outflow tract confusables.

core: Nuclear steroid and thyroid hormone receptor signaling
qualifier: estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid receptors
name: Sex steroid and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signalling and responses; the combined sex-steroid plus thyroid receptor scope separates it from RUNX2, liver, retinoic acid and estrous-cycle confusables.

qualifier: A2E formation and light-induced retinal damage
name: Visual cycle chromophore recycling, A2E and light damage
rationale: All members concern the rod/cone retinoid (visual) cycle, its RDH5/RDH12/ABCA4 defects and A2E-linked light damage, distinct from general vitamin A metabolism and opsin phototransduction confusables.

name: De novo purine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: All members describe de novo synthesis of IMP and AMP, distinct from purine salvage, PRPP, folate and pyrimidine synthesis confusables.

qualifier: monoaminergic, sympathetic and sensory neurons
name: Axon guidance of monoaminergic, sympathetic and sensory neurons
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and target innervation by dopaminergic, serotonergic, sympathetic and dorsal root ganglion neurons, rather than the cranial nerve or netrin/semaphorin signalling of the confusables.

qualifier: glycolipid, ceramide-1-phosphate and phosphoinositide carriers
name: Non-vesicular intermembrane transfer of glycolipids and phospholipids
rationale: Members describe protein-mediated lipid transfer between membranes (glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate, PI/PC), distinct from flippases, vesicular ER traffic and phospholipid synthesis confusables.

qualifier: HPRT1-mediated hypoxanthine/guanine salvage to IMP
name: HPRT1-mediated purine nucleobase salvage
rationale: All three members are hypoxanthine/guanine salvage to IMP via HPRT1, distinct from purine catabolism, deoxypurine metabolism and broader ribonucleoside salvage confusables.

core: Urea cycle and ammonia nitrogen disposal
qualifier: inherited urea cycle and arginine/ornithine transport defects
name: Urea cycle nitrogen disposal and its inherited defects
rationale: Members cover the urea cycle, ammonia handling, linked glutamate/aspartate/arginine/ornithine metabolism and transport, and inherited urea cycle disorders, unlike the proline, glycine-conjugation and GABA confusables.

core: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division control
qualifier: spindle, cohesion and checkpoint, mainly female meiosis
name: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division, mainly oocyte meiosis
rationale: Members concern meiotic spindle assembly, sister chromatid cohesion, segregation and meiotic cell-cycle control, largely in female meiosis, rather than the recombination and synapsis of the confusables.

qualifier: lipoxygenase products, lipoxins, LTB4 inactivation, PAF
name: Lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoid and platelet-activating factor metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis and catabolism of lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids (5-/15-HETE, lipoxins, LTB4) plus PAF/ether lipid turnover, distinct from cysteinyl-leukotriene signalling and cytochrome P450 HETE/EET confusables.

qualifier: glutamate and acetylcholine release
name: Vesicle docking and SNARE priming in glutamate and acetylcholine release
rationale: Members concern vesicle docking, SNARE assembly and priming in glutamate and acetylcholine release cycles, separating it from monoamine release, Rab signalling and calcium-triggered fusion confusables.

qualifier: PPAR/PGC-1alpha adipogenesis and circadian clock
name: Transcriptional control of adipogenesis, mitochondrial biogenesis and circadian clock
rationale: Members describe nuclear receptor and PGC-1alpha transcriptional programmes for white adipogenesis, fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial biogenesis and clock genes, unlike the LXR, gluconeogenesis and circadian-only confusables.

qualifier: p53 stabilisation and Cdc25A degradation
name: G2 DNA damage checkpoint with p53 and Cdc25A turnover
rationale: All members concern the radiation-induced G2 checkpoint acting through phosphorylation and ubiquitin-mediated turnover of p53, COP1 and Cdc25A, distinct from G2/M recovery and DNA repair transcription confusables.

qualifier: complement cascade, antimicrobial peptides, neutrophil granule killing
name: Complement, antimicrobial peptides and neutrophil granule microbial killing
rationale: Members cover direct host killing and opsonisation of microbes via complement, defensins, neutrophil granule proteins and metal sequestration, unlike confusables centred on neutrophil migration, macrophage state and Fc receptor signalling.

core: Hormonal and glucose-sensing control of fuel metabolism
qualifier: glucagon-PKA and ChREBP transcription
name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing control of gluconeogenesis and lipolysis
rationale: Members concern glucagon-PKA, PDE3B/PP2A and ChREBP/carbon-catabolite signalling regulating gluconeogenesis and triglyceride turnover, distinct from glycogen, insulin, LXR lipogenesis and adipogenesis confusables.

name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy
rationale: All members concern aggresome assembly and its autophagic clearance, distinct from ERAD, chaperone-mediated/microautophagy, stress granules and protein refolding confusables.

Members mix a Fanconi anemia/monoubiquitination core with heterogeneous expression modules (polycomb chromatin, RB1/BCL2L1, mitochondrial housekeeping, centrosomal) plus ribosome assembly and inner cell mass proliferation, with no biological theme shared by all.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
qualifier: iron, heme, copper and manganese
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover uptake, transport and homeostasis of iron (transferrin, heme, ferroportin defects), copper, manganese and cobalt, distinct from cadmium detoxification, scavenger receptor and oxygen transport confusables.

qualifier: bidirectional COPII and COPI transport
name: Bidirectional ER-Golgi vesicle traffic by COPII and COPI
rationale: Members cover COPII ER export and COPI Golgi-to-ER retrograde and anterograde transport, distinct from intra-Golgi traffic, Golgi organisation and vesicle tethering confusables.

core: Testis development and male sex determination
qualifier: Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell regulation
name: Testis development, male sex determination and germ cell regulation
rationale: Members concern male gonad determination and differentiation (Sertoli, Leydig, seminiferous tubules, AMH) and germ cell migration, proliferation and meiotic entry, distinct from ovarian and genital tract confusables.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor signalling and degranulation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and degranulation
rationale: Members concern neutrophil recruitment, migration control and degranulation driven by formyl peptide and complement receptors, distinct from monocyte, TLR and positive chemotaxis/extravasation confusables.
